notes.title: PRIM 1.3 Update
notes.content:
Dear friends of the Realm of the Dead!

We would like to take this opportunity to thank you for all the feedback and support we have received for PRIM!  Since PRIM was first released, we have added several patches. We've made usability tweaks, edited content and fixed small bugs that some of you players have reported. Thank you for doing so and we will continue to do our best to respond to every bug report!  

You can find a complete list of all patches here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1510470/discussions/1/4695658043402203607/  


We are excited to release update 1.3! 


This release concentrates on bugfixes, improved gamepad-controls and quality-of-live-or-death optimisations.  

Some of the changes and fixes are:

Pressing the middle mouse-button now shows hotspots

Better scaling of cursors and hotspot-names

Better scaling of artwork provided by the backers

Removed banding on some graphics

Updated included frameworks and the underlying runtime

Several performance-optimisations (e.g.: reduced stutter when loading scenes)

Improvements to gamepad-controls (e.g.: Prim's walking-animation stops at the borders of walkable areas)

Increased size of all small hotspots

Fixes for Prim's Room, The Book of the Dead, In Front of the Fates' Place and several other places...



Artbook, Soundtrack and Bundles

Meanwhile the PRIM Soundtrack and Artbook have been released. Click here to open the Soundtrack
Click here to open the Artbook  



Pro tip: If you own the game already you can add Artbook and Soundtrack with an extra discount via the Deluxe Edition bundle below. 

Click here to go to the Deluxe Edition 



Yet another recommendation: We have joined forces with Revolution Software to put together a bundle. If you already own PRIM, you can buy Broken Swords: Shadow of the Templars - Reforged at a reduced price here.

 Click here to see the Bundle

Have fun with the update and keep enjoying PRIM!

Deadly greetings!
The PRIM team


P.S. If you liked our game, please write a recommendation!
We are happy about every review! 🙂

notes.title: PRIM wins Best Family Game at DCP 2025
notes.content:
Dear friends of the Realm of the Dead!

We have great news about PRIM! On 14.05.2025, the German Computer Game Award 2025 was being awarded in 16 categories. PRIM was one of the three nominated games in the category “Best Family Game” and won this category.

We are very proud of this recognition of our work and of course we can also make good use of the 40,000 euros in prize money.

If you would like to watch the award ceremony, you can find the key scene in this YouTube video https://www.youtube.com/live/1DBMg7KEbA8?si=kjV5PctMZDHVrmOs&t=7101


Deadly greetings!
The PRIM team


P.S. If you liked our game, please write a recommendation!
We are happy about every review! 🙂

notes.title: PRIM 1.2 Update and new demo...
notes.content:
Dear friends of the Realm of the Dead!

We would like to take this opportunity to thank you for all the feedback and support we have received for PRIM!

Since PRIM was first released, we have added several patches. We've made usability tweaks, edited content and fixed small bugs that some of you players have reported. Thank you for doing so and we will continue to do our best to respond to every bug report!

You can find a complete list of all patches here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1510470/discussions/1/4695658043402203607/


We are excited to release update 1.2!

The biggest new feature: a new demo!
The demo is now based on the sources of the actual game and is not based on an earlier prototype any more. This means: it has been translated into several languages, has English and German audio and it supports mouse and gamepad-controls - all the things the main game supports as well - it is just a bit shorter...

Other improvements

 The game uses a lot less main memory and level-loading should be a bit quicker as a consequence.
 Improved Lip-sync - mainly the scene in the attic has been redone.
 Many smaller bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: PRIM 1.1 Update and more...
notes.content:
Dear friends of the Realm of the Dead!

We would like to take this opportunity to thank you for all the feedback and support we have received for PRIM!

Since PRIM was first released, we have added six patches. We've made usability tweaks, edited content and fixed bugs that some of you players have reported. Thank you for doing so and we will continue to do our best to respond to every bug report!

You can find a complete list of all patches here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1510470/discussions/1/4695658043402203607/


We are excited to release update 1.1!

The biggest new feature: Trading cards!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538418/00dadf2005be611531586f34788bc5c6edfe80ea.png
There are now five trading cards for PRIM that you can unlock and trade. There's also more community content like badges, backgrounds and emotes!

Other improvements

 We've listened to your wishes and reworked the mouse and gamepad controls.
 We've also made the Casketball card game more accessible and now give you the option to skip this quest earlier, should you not enjoy the card game too much.
 We have imported corrections for all localisations.

notes.title: The free PRIM demo is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hey Reapers!

The dead cat is out of the bag! After months of working off our bony buttocks, the PRIM demo is finally released and we can't wait to hear what you guys think about it!

Key features:

a playtime of 30-60 minutes
classical point'n'click gameplay with modern perks
quirky characters, such as Death himself or an eyeball with spider legs
handdrawn 2D graphics
an atmospheric, orchestral soundtrack 
English and German voice over
Texts in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Russian and Brazilian Portuguese
 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1511380
